#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    explicit InputReader(istream& inStream) : in(inStream) {}
    int nextInt() {
        int c;
        do {
            c = in.get();
        } while (isspace(c));
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = in.get();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                throw runtime_error("Invalid input");
            }
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = in.get();
        } while (!isspace(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }
private:
    istream& in;
};

class OutputWriter {
public:
    explicit OutputWriter(ostream& outStream) : out(outStream) {}
    void println(long long i) {
        out << i << "\n";
    }
    void close() {
        // no action needed
    }
private:
    ostream& out;
};

struct HopcroftKarp {
    int m, n;
    vector<vector<int>> g;
    vector<int> pairU, pairV, dis;
    const int inf = INT_MAX;
    const int NIL = 0;

    HopcroftKarp(int m_, int n_, const vector<vector<int>>& g_) : m(m_), n(n_), g(g_) {
        pairU.assign(m + 1, NIL);
        pairV.assign(n + 1, NIL);
        dis.assign(m + 1, 0);
    }

    int maximumMatching() {
        int matching = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            for (int u = 1; u <= m; u++) {
                if (pairU[u] == NIL && dfs(u))
                    matching++;
            }
        }
        return matching;
    }

private:
    bool bfs() {
        queue<int> q;
        for (int u = 1; u <= m; u++) {
            if (pairU[u] == NIL) {
                dis[u] = 0;
                q.push(u);
            } else {
                dis[u] = inf;
            }
        }
        dis[NIL] = inf;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (dis[u] < dis[NIL]) {
                for (int v : g[u]) {
                    if (dis[pairV[v]] == inf) {
                        dis[pairV[v]] = dis[u] + 1;
                        q.push(pairV[v]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dis[NIL] != inf;
    }

    bool dfs(int u) {
        if (u != NIL) {
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                if (dis[pairV[v]] == dis[u] + 1) {
                    if (dfs(pairV[v])) {
                        pairV[v] = u;
                        pairU[u] = v;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            dis[u] = inf;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    OutputWriter out(cout);

    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();

    long long ans = 0;

    if (n > 100) {
        int nn = (n - 100) % 6;
        long long nq = (n - 100) / 6;
        ans += nq * 6LL * m;
        n = 100 + nn;
    }

    if (m > 100) {
        int nm = (m - 100) % 6;
        long long mq = (m - 100) / 6;
        ans += mq * 6LL * n;
        m = 100 + nm;
    }

    vector<vector<int>> mat(n + 1, vector<int>(m + 1, 0));
    int u = 1, v = 1;

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                mat[i][j] = u++;
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 != 0) {
                mat[i][j] = v++;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<int>> g(u, vector<int>());
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                auto addEdge = [&](int si, int sj, int ti, int tj) {
                    if (ti >= 1 && ti <= n && tj >= 1 && tj <= m) {
                        g[mat[si][sj]].push_back(mat[ti][tj]);
                    }
                };
                addEdge(i, j, i - 3, j);
                addEdge(i, j, i - 2, j - 1);
                addEdge(i, j, i - 2, j + 1);
                addEdge(i, j, i, j - 3);
                addEdge(i, j, i - 1, j - 2);
                addEdge(i, j, i + 1, j - 2);
                addEdge(i, j, i, j + 3);
                addEdge(i, j, i - 1, j + 2);
                addEdge(i, j, i + 1, j + 2);
                addEdge(i, j, i + 3, j);
                addEdge(i, j, i + 2, j - 1);
                addEdge(i, j, i + 2, j + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    HopcroftKarp bpm(u - 1, v - 1, g);
    ans += 2LL * bpm.maximumMatching();

    out.println(ans);
    return 0;
}
